method.content_detection: case-insensitive heuristic patterns; aggregate counts only

risk_notes: Pattern matches indicate review surface, not confirmed identity or sensitivity.
Historical profiles can contain email, ICQ, MSN, occupation, location and similar public-at-the-time fields.
Messages may contain personal or sensitive information supplied by their authors.
Images, attachments and text can remain protected by third-party copyright.
The age of the material does not extinguish privacy or copyright rights.

mitigations.search: local Pagefind without analytics or backend

residual_risks: Personal data can still occur in preserved discussion text when it is part of the historical message.
No automated detector can determine authorship, consent, age, identity or legal sensitivity conclusively.
Search engines and third parties may retain caches outside the project's control.
Accepted removal requests must also be applied to public release assets under project control.
This technical audit is not legal advice.
